title: Austin's Lake Sewer Line Contract
summary:
*   Austin's city leaders convened a special meeting to address a single, crucial infrastructure development.
*   The main purpose was to award a contract for the construction of a new sewer line project.
*   This significant utility expansion would stretch along Lake Austin, connecting West 35th Street to the Taylor Slough Lift Station.
*   The focused agenda highlights the city's commitment to developing essential public services and water management systems.
transcript:
= CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: Notice is hereby given that a
Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin will be held on the 13th day of
September, 1967, at the Municipal Building, Eighth and Colorado, in Austin, Texas, at
2:00P.M. for the purpose of awarding a contract for sewer line along Lake Austin from West
35th Street to
Taylor Slough Lift Station.
s/ Elsie Woosley
City Clerk
s/ Harry Akin
Mayor
City of Austin, Texas
ATTEST:
s/ Elsie Woosley
City Clerk
CONSENT TO MEETING
We, the undersigned members of the City Council, hereby accept service of the foregoing
notice, waiving any and all irregularities in such service and such notice, and consent
and agree that said City Council shall meet at the time and place therein named, and for
the purpose therein stated. s/ Emma Long
s/ Dick Nichols
s/ Travis LaRue
s/ R. E. Janes, Jr.
